transport.observedTransactionIds: 5-bit sequence cycling evenly through 00..1F; the stream begins at 09 but does not keep 09 fixed.

observedTransitions.classification: The two activations bound the setting changes. Transition frames follow each activation; the selected Wheel cycle is inside the stable repeated interval, and Fire is independently present before the first and after the second transition.

fire.status: Observed exact-model bounded sample loop; native Fire is non-periodic in this recording

wheelCounterClockwise.derivation: Evaluate the observed clockwise cycle at (cycleDuration - elapsed) modulo cycleDuration; equivalently reverse both frame order and inter-frame durations.
wheelCounterClockwise.reasoning: The direction is encoded by temporal progression of the same spatial color-wheel states, so reversing time gives a meaningful opposite rotation without inventing RGB values.
